6.374 rsInvalidGroupingContainerNotNaturalGroup
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidGroupingContainerNotNaturalGroup is a non-critical error that will occur when a Group
specifies NaturalGroup but the containing Group does not use NaturalGroup.
